snippet.title: Tanks! Official Announcement Trailer | Tanks! - C&K Games
snippet.description:
Get Ready Soldier!
You have been approved for the digital tank operator training program.

Fight For Your Country!
Complete 25 increasingly difficult missions in Campaign mode. Fight a diverse selection of enemy tanks, each with their own gimmicks. From the immobile brown tank, to the invisible white tank, to the deadeye green tank, it won't be an easy task.

Face The Brutality Of War!
Upgrade your tank in Endless mode. With rouge-like elements, you'll fight hundreds of tanks, defeat unique bosses, and become more powerful than you can image. Or you'll die over, and over, and over again.

Enlist Your Friends!
Work together in Co-op Campaign; now with even more brutal levels! And with no extra lives, you'll have to work together to defeat all 25 missions. Or, play competitively and try to get the highest score by destroying the most tanks.

Prove You're Worthy!
Fight to the death with up to 3 other players in Last Tank Standing. Be the last player alive at the end of each round to earn points. Set a custom amount of rounds, and at the end, be the one with the highest score to see the other players go BOOM!

Download Tanks! Now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769940/Tanks/

Join the C&K Games Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/6v6Ag3E8gf
